title: Up to 25% off Space Saver Spare Wheel Kit for Tesla, MG4 etc: e.g. MG4 Kit with Jack & Carry Bag $590 + Del @ Cybermetals
body:
Deal: Up to 25% off Space Saver Spare Wheel Kit for Tesla, MG4 etc: e.g. MG4 Kit with Jack & Carry Bag $590 + Del @ Cybermetals

[sixtyeleven] Looks like they've caused abit of stir in the MG4 Urban* community - it fits the hub but their space saver is bigger than expected, which isnt good. Anyone with this model probably best to consider other brands that offer better fit.
[0jay] caused abit of stir in the MG4 Urban* community
not sure how big of a community there is given that vehicle's just been released
they address rim size onsite
Worried about your factory wheel size?
A vehicle may be offered with multiple factory wheel size options, but spare wheel compatibility is determined by more than wheel diameter alone. CyberMetals spare tyre kits are engineered specifically for your vehicle application, taking into account fitment, load capacity and emergency-use requirements.
from the Braumach site
Why "Rim Size" Isn't important : It's All About The Wheel Diameter!
When it comes to replacing your car’s spare wheel, rim size isn’t the big deal you might think—what truly matters is the outer wheel diameter staying consistent, within a few millimeters of your cars original tyre size. The Braumach 18-inch and 19-inch Spare Wheel is engineered to fit a wide range of rim sizes, from 17" to 22", making it a versatile and reliable solution for most vehicles.
[tanastra] I ended up with Brau caused its Faster shipping, $100 voucher to pay for shipping, while Cyber never sent me email for the 25% off ( 1 week now) , and $45 shipping unless above $600. I

that popup's misleading, they just want you on the mailing list. the discount's already applied

can also get a used spacesaver from a vw/audi etc with the same bolt pattern for probly a fraction of the cost for one of these but it's steel (so heavier) etc etc

course it's matching
